notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Morgue Toad with haste.
Activate the five Morgue Toad tokens by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the Morgue Toad tokens die, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Morgue Toad tokens and/or target any other creature.
